about.title: Rich, Roger and the crew
paragraphs: Cascade Motors is owned by Rich, and with Roger and the crew we've earned a reputation in The Dalles for honest work and fair prices.
We'll keep you in the loop from start to finish, and we'll tell you straight if a repair is worth doing. Locals and travelers passing through on I-84 count on us alike.

estimate.title: What's going on with your car?
estimate.text: Tell us what your vehicle is doing and we will get back to you. Or call (541) 296-1131 (Mon–Fri: 8am–5pm).
estimate.thanks: Thanks! We will get back to you soon to set up a time.
